name: Thos. Emerson & Co.
goods: horses kept by the day or week

locations.basis: The register resolved no place for this house at the scene date.
locations.limit_reason: No street the model holds. The anchor 'the Point (Wolf Point, the forks of the Chicago river)' names nothing the committed town holds.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1834-02-18, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

proprietor_community.basis: This record names nobody the resident layer holds a card for, so there is no person to read a community off. The silence is in the register.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
